What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.26

  • Clean Desktop, for Music Mode: while the album is on your desktop, the icons, widgets, Dock and menu bar step aside and the screen's edges darken, leaving just the album.
  • Switch it on or off from the notch's right-click menu or the menu bar icon's menu. The Dock and the menu bar still slide in when you move the pointer to them.
  • Your own Dock and menu bar settings come back when Music Mode or Clean Desktop turns off, or when ShawNotch quits.
